projects.title: Automated Subscriptions
projects.summary: Automatic billing for ERPNext Subscriptions, with payment requests, billing anchors, proration, consolidated invoices, and credit notes.

projects.title: Avunu Odoo Addons
projects.summary: Avunu's Odoo 18 Community modules for email and SMS, document import, AI providers, and the backend and shop-floor UI, built to work alongside OCA.

projects.title: Carbon Frappe
projects.summary: A complete IBM Carbon Design System theme for Frappe and ERPNext, covering the desk, website, login, email, charts, and tables.

projects.title: Cloudflare Email Delivery
projects.summary: Send and receive Frappe and ERPNext email through Cloudflare, with no SMTP or IMAP provider in the loop.

projects.title: Cloudflare Email Relay
projects.summary: A multi-tenant Cloudflare Email Routing Worker that stores every inbound message and pushes it to the right Odoo or Frappe instance with durable retries.

projects.title: ERPNext CIS Plus
projects.summary: Simpler customer, contact, and address management for ERPNext, with address validation, geolocation, and a map of your customers.

projects.title: ERPNext TaskView
projects.summary: A project and task workspace for ERPNext, with timers and hour budgets for staff and a portal where customers follow and work on their projects.

projects.title: eSign
projects.summary: Collect electronic signatures on any Frappe or ERPNext document through web forms, with signed PDFs and a full audit trail.

projects.title: frappe-nix
projects.summary: Reproducible Nix infrastructure for Frappe and ERPNext, from the development shell to OCI containers and a multi-site NixOS module.

projects.title: Jailbreak
projects.summary: Power-user tools for Frappe and ERPNext admins, including bulk merge, item-to-variant conversion, and version restore, each gated behind a setting.

projects.title: Jx
projects.summary: A full-stack web framework and visual editor built on plain JSON and Markdown, compiling sites to fast, static HTML.

projects.title: Mercury Integration
projects.summary: Connects ERPNext to Mercury bank for client billing, payroll and vendor ACH, bank sync, reconciliation, and GL-coded journal entries.

projects.title: Messaging
projects.summary: A unified chat-style inbox for email and SMS in Frappe and ERPNext, with Twilio texting, group broadcasts, and mail-merge newsletters.

projects.title: NixOS Micro Desktop
projects.summary: A low-maintenance NixOS desktop inspired by openSUSE Aeon, set up once and then managed through GNOME Software and Flatpak.

projects.title: nixos-rclone
projects.summary: A NixOS module and Rust daemon for rclone mounts and two-way sync that pushes local changes in seconds, with Markdown-to-docx conversion built in.

projects.title: Odoo AI Cloudflare Gateway
projects.summary: Adds Cloudflare Workers AI as a MuK AI provider in Odoo 18, optionally routed through a named Cloudflare AI Gateway for usage tracking.

projects.title: Odoo Document Import
projects.summary: Odoo 18 modules that turn vendor emails, PDFs, and printed documents into Odoo records, with templates, structured extraction, previews, and routing.

projects.title: Odoo Email and Messaging
projects.summary: Odoo 18 modules that send and receive email through Cloudflare and run two-way Twilio SMS and MMS conversations inside Discuss.

projects.title: Odoo UI and Shop Floor
projects.summary: Odoo 18 modules for a Carbon-styled backend, a live timesheet timer in the navbar, and camera scanning and social sign-in for the OCA Shopfloor app.

projects.title: odoo-nix
projects.summary: Reproducible Nix infrastructure for Odoo Community (OCB) and OCA projects, from scaffolding and development to containers and NixOS.

projects.title: PostGrid Integration
projects.summary: Mail printed Frappe and ERPNext documents as physical letters through PostGrid, by hand or automatically from Notifications.

projects.title: Web Kiosk
projects.summary: A USB-booting NixOS image that turns an x86 computer into a locked-down Firefox kiosk for a single web page.

projects.title: WordPress Cloudflare Email
projects.summary: Routes all WordPress email through the Cloudflare Email Sending API and keeps a searchable log of every message, with no settings screen.

projects.title: WordPress JWT Auth
projects.summary: Replaces WordPress logins with single sign-on through an OIDC provider or an identity-aware proxy, configured entirely in wp-config.php.

projects.title: wordpress-nix
projects.summary: A fast FrankenPHP WordPress stack built with Nix, deployable as OCI containers or a NixOS module, with MySQL, Cloudflare D1, or Turso databases.

projects.title: WP Cloud Files
projects.summary: Stores and serves the WordPress media library from S3-compatible object storage, with direct browser uploads and document thumbnails.
